mapping_cone.graph: J_C f=(f,Cf) in H direct-sum H
mapping_cone.categorical_role: the two summands are adjacent grades in the Hilbert totalization/mapping cone of C

rate_one_boundary_lift.normalized: J_C R/||J_C R|| has coefficient pair (4/5,3/5) relative to the normalized copies of R

angle.meaning: 4/5 is the projection of the normalized graph state back to the base/bulk summand; 3/5 is its boundary/completion component

higher_totalization.standard_mechanism: iterated mapping cones or total cofibers place face data in shifted direct-sum grades
higher_totalization.orthogonality: a Hilbert totalization declares distinct grades orthogonal; normalized graph inclusions then produce cosine/sine coefficients
higher_totalization.simplex_link: a filled higher simplex can supply the compatible differentials whose total cofiber is formed, but the Hilbert/Clifford totalization supplies the orthogonal metric

not_C4.quarter_turn: the Clifford C4 generator has angle pi/2 and square -I
not_C4.graph_rotation: U has cosine 4/5 and generally infinite order
not_C4.relation: the C4 quarter-turn can act on the doubled cone and exchange graph/normal directions, but U itself is not that quarter-turn
not_C4.invariance_test: changing the Poisson lift rate changes the graph angle while leaving the C4 action unchanged

general_operator_form.complement: the Halmos/Julia graph rotation supplies the orthogonal normal and a unitary on H direct-sum H

conclusion: The 3-4-5 pattern does have a standard categorical-analytic role: it is the normalized graph inclusion of the completion map inside its Hilbert mapping cone. The 4/5 is a graph-angle cosine, not a modulo-four or simplex-count invariant. Higher simplex coherence may canonically specify the map being coned; graph/Clifford totalization then yields the Pythagorean coefficients.
